response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical expertise across 20 years of software development with solid contributions to developer tooling and code quality, he lacks essential management experience required for this mid-senior leadership position. Most critically, there is no evidence of people management or team leadership experience—required minimums of 2 and 3 years respectively. This role explicitly demands a full-time people-leadership focus including performance management, one-on-ones, and team development, none of which appear in his resume. His teaching and mentoring background suggest potential for a future transition to management, but he is currently better suited for a principal engineer or senior IC track.
strengths: Exceptional technical depth with 20 years of development experience and demonstrated expertise in testing frameworks, CI/CD infrastructure, and developer tooling critical to engineering productivity
Proven ability to lead open-source projects (GISCollective) and mentor engineers through workshops and training programs, indicating foundational knowledge-sharing and communication skills
Staff-level technical contributor with strong system design expertise across multiple domains and proven ability to architect complex infrastructure and tools
concerns: Complete absence of formal people management or direct report experience, which is fundamentally required for this full-time people-leadership role
No demonstrated experience with team performance management, career development discussions, one-on-ones, or establishing performance expectations—all explicit role responsibilities

Developer tools experience is dispersed across CI/CD infrastructure, open-source testing libraries, and recent tooling work rather than representing a focused 3-year career investment in build systems or automation
